parts.name: Sphere
parts.Basic_description: The sphere is the main part of the globe, made of plastic, representing the Earth with printed maps. It has a diameter of approximately 25 cm.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the visual representation of the Earth, showing continents, oceans, and countries. It can rotate around its axis for educational and demonstrative purposes.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate freely around its tilted axis supported by the base body.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the supporting structure of the globe, made of metal, with a circular base and an arm holding the sphere. It is approximately 15 cm tall.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and support to the rotating sphere, maintaining the globe’s upright position and allowing smooth rotation.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during normal use, serving as a fixed support for the rotating sphere.
